notes.title: RX Racing 2022 Pro (Update #1)
notes.content:
[b]First update of the game which includes :[/b]

- The sounds of the engines , whether electric or thermal , have been revised . I wanted an electric sound that was a bit louder and more realistic like this one

[url=https://youtu.be/8hv0P8eoR94]Superpole World RX Spain[/url] 


- New updated from the Unity game engine which is the most recent one 

- Added in the "Control/Graphics" menu how to launch a race because there is a graphic bug that I left because there was no consequence on the game and no need to say that the game is broken



 And also one last thing , when you do a review you should play at least the new features of the game which takes well over 10 minutes and if you see a bug , stop amplifying the thing by making it look like it is broken . [b]Also , when you buy a game , you can always get your money back if you don't like the game .[/b]
For the trailer , it's true that it's dated because I made it the day of my preparation to release it on steam and well before making the gameplay videos which are more recent and with the latest features and which are available on my YouTube channel .

notes.title: RX Racing 2022 Pro is out now !!!
notes.content:
[b]The new game RX Racing 2022 Pro is out with new features :[/b]

notes.title: RX Racing 2022 Pro (Controller)
notes.content:
RX Racing 2022 Pro will be the first game where the player can use the controllers only during the races .

[u]In this game, you can use as a controller :
[/u]

- XBOX controller ( this game has been specifically developed with Enhanced Wired Controller by PowerA )

- Nacon PC/PS4 compatible controller ( WARNING !!! if you want to use a PS4 controller , I think it's possible but I think you have to use a program or something else to play )

[u]What's the point of using a controller ?[/u]


- More concentration during the races 
- Another way of driving than the keyboard
- The player can stall on the starting grid
- The player is more likely to make mistakes

All in all, it's a lot closer to a real rallycross , but still arcade-like .

As usual, you can play with the keyboard like in my previous RX Racing and Race On Ice games . 

WARNING !!! the keyboard is configured in AZERTY mode so if you have a QWERTY keyboard, there is one or two letters that change .

Trailer : [url=https://youtu.be/UsgmK8TwyB0]Trailer RX Racing 2022 Pro[/url]

notes.content:

notes.title: Race On Ice 2020 Pro
notes.content:
Race On Ice 2020 Pro is an  ice racing game where you can drive the drivers of the year 2020 . The goal is very simple, you take a driver and try to win the race. But be careful because depending on the driver you take, it will be more difficult to win the race.

Feature :

3 Modes : Time Attack , Race and Season 

Time Attack :

Train on one of the 6 circuits for improve yourself .

Race :

There are 12 pilots who are divided into more than 6 teams. So choose a driver and try to lead him to victory.

 Season :

- Season 2019-2020 of  R.O.I Pro

 12 drivers  6 teams and 6 tracks 

Race with 5-6 cars               Season 6 races



Only keyboards and mouse

This game includes :

- Fake names - Fake tracks - Fake teams - Fake cars

No licence
